connectPage.unknownPlatform: This platform is not available here.

credentials.invalid: The platform rejected this. Check it and try again.
credentials.noAccounts: These credentials work, but they reach no account.

checklist.intro: These accounts can be connected with what you entered.

checklist.skippedElsewhere_other: {{count}} accounts were skipped because someone else already has them connected.

oauthResult.provider_error: The platform reported a problem. Try again in a moment.
oauthResult.exchange_failed: The platform did not finish the sign-in. Try again.
oauthResult.scope_missing: postit needs every permission it asks for. Start again and allow them all.
oauthResult.discovery_failed: postit could not read your accounts from the platform. Try again.
oauthResult.no_accounts: This sign-in has no accounts to connect.
oauthResult.platform_unavailable: This platform is not available right now. Try again later.
oauthResult.state_invalid: This sign-in link is no longer valid. Start again.
oauthResult.account_connected_elsewhere: Someone else already has that account connected.
